title: Blue Floral Seamless Pattern Set
author: All-Of-Art
description:
Add timeless charm to your creative projects with this versatile collection of 12 blue and cream seamless patterns. Featuring delicate floral prints, botanical sprigs, classic geometric ornaments, playful polka dots, elegant stripes, and traditional plaid checks, this coordinated set combines fresh botanical style with classic decorative patterns.
The soft blue, ivory, and sage green color palette creates a calm, sophisticated look that works beautifully for both modern and vintage-inspired designs. From cottagecore aesthetics and preppy style to timeless floral stationery, these patterns offer a variety of complementary designs for countless creative applications.
WHAT’S INCLUDED
12 unique seamless repeating patterns
EPS vector files for scalable, editable artwork
JPG files for convenient use in digital and print projects
PERFECT FOR
Fabric and textile design
Sewing projects and clothing prints
Scrapbooking and digital paper
Gift wrapping and packaging
Greeting cards and invitations
Planners, journals, and stationery
Wallpaper and home decor
Surface pattern design
Print-on-demand products
Branding and decorative backgrounds
DESIGN STYLE
Blue floral, botanical, classic geometric, polka dot, striped, and plaid patterns in a coordinated blue, cream, and sage green palette.
Create cohesive collections, mix and match complementary prints, or use individual patterns to bring a refined decorative touch to your next project.
FILE FORMATS: EPS and JPG
